harvestIndicators: Mow when stalks reach 3 to 4 feet tall, leaving at least 6 inches of stubble
Disk while plants are still vegetative to speed decomposition
Or flail-chop after frost to leave a mulch for no-till planting
notes: Massive summer biomass for soil-building. Mow at 4 ft to encourage rooting + regrowth. Allelopathic — wait 2 wk before planting small-seeded crops.

animalToxicity.note: Young regrowth and plants stressed by drought or frost can release prussic acid. Ask your extension agent or vet before grazing it.
